## Brief table

| the brief names or implies | file(s) that deliver it |
|---|---|
| Fix monthly-total bug (2026-08 = 13,341.00, not 91.00) — comma amounts were parsed as 0 | `ledger/parse.py` `parse_amount` (strip commas before `float`) |
| Unparseable amount must not silently count as zero | `ledger/parse.py` `parse_amount` (raise `ValueError`) |
| Add `top(entries, n)` → dict month → n most expensive, desc, ties by category | `ledger/report.py` `top`; exported in `ledger/__init__.py` |
| Update README with a `top` example | `README.md` |
| **A test that fails before the change and passes after** | `tests/test_ledger.py` (all new tests) |
| Error path — wrong type / garbage amount | `parse_amount` raises `ValueError` → `test_parse_amount_unparseable_raises`, `test_parse_line_unparseable_amount_raises` |
| Error path — negative / out-of-range `n` | `top` clamps via `max(0, n)` → `test_top_n_zero_or_negative_returns_empty_lists` |
| Error path — empty input | `top([], n)` → `{}` → `test_top_empty_entries_returns_empty_dict` |
| Error path — missing file | `load` raises `FileNotFoundError` (unmodified, natural — not touched by this diff) |
| Doc line | `README.md` `top` example |
| New dependency | none |
